title: DSID
summary: A UUID-style identifier in SORA Nexus assigned to every data space, used for transaction routing, policy lookup, and cross-space access control throughout the network.
definition: A UUID-style identifier in SORA Nexus assigned to every data space, used for transaction routing, policy lookup, and cross-space access control throughout the network.
tagline: Provides a universal address for any data space, enabling validators and applications to route transactions and enforce policies without ambiguity.
